topic: An artist discovers someone has tattooed their work
text: My work, my lines, my hours under the harsh light, now marred. Someone dared, with no right, no invitation, to mark over it. My skin crawls at the thought of my art, twisted, no longer pure. How dare they? Each stroke was a whisper of my soul, now screamed into something... else. The canvas, my sanctuary, violated. It was perfect until their hands, those careless, thoughtless hands, altered what was meant to be. They took, they defaced, they thought it theirs to change. It was never theirs. Now, the piece, it's different, and I see it, twisted, through their lens. This was not meant to be.
